By the star, the Prophet has not strayed; his words are revelation taught by Gabriel, intense in strength, whom he saw near and again at the Lote Tree.
Al-Lat, al-'Uzza and Manat are mere names without authority from Allah, an unjust division giving Him females; those who named them follow assumption and desire, though guidance came.
The angels' intercession avails only with Allah's permission; those who disbelieve in the Hereafter give angels female names, following assumption without knowledge.
Turn away from whoever ignores the message and wants only worldly life; that is all they know, and Allah knows best who strays and who is guided.
Allah repays evildoers for their deeds and rewards those who do good, who avoid major sins and immoralities, with the best; He is vast in forgiveness, so claim no purity.
One who turned away and gave little is reminded that the scriptures of Moses and Abraham say no one bears another's burden and each has only what he strives for.
To Allah is the final return; He makes people laugh and weep, gives death and life, creates male and female from a sperm-drop, enriches, and is Lord of Sirius.
Allah destroyed the first 'Aad, Thamud and Noah's people, who were more unjust, and hurled down the overturned towns, then asks which of His favors people doubt.
The Prophet is a warner like those before; the Approaching Day has drawn near and none but Allah can remove it, so prostrate to Allah and worship Him.
The Hour has come near and the moon has split, yet seeing a miracle they turn away calling it passing magic, follow their inclinations, and warning does not avail them.
The Prophet is to leave them; when the Caller calls, they will emerge from graves like spreading locusts, racing to him, and disbelievers will call it a difficult Day.
Noah's people called him a madman, so he prayed for help; rain poured and springs burst, he was carried on planks, and the Quran is made easy to remember.
'Aad, the people of Hud, denied, so Allah sent a screaming wind on a day of continuous misfortune, uprooting people like palm trunks; the Quran is made easy for remembrance.
Thamud rejected following Salih, one human among them, as an insolent liar; the she-camel was a trial with shared water, their companion hamstrung her, and one blast destroyed them.
Lot's people denied the warning and demanded his guests, so Allah sent a storm of stones and obliterated their eyes, saving Lot's family before dawn as a favor.
A warning came to Pharaoh's people through Moses and Aaron, but they denied all Allah's signs, so He seized them with the seizure of one Exalted in Might.
The disbelievers of Quraysh are asked if they are better than earlier peoples or immune by scripture; their assembly will be defeated and flee, and the Hour is their appointment.
The criminals are in error and madness; on the Day they are dragged into the Fire on their faces, they will be told to taste the touch of Saqar.
Allah created all things with predestination, His command is done like a glance of the eye, and He has already destroyed your kinds.
Everything they did is in written records, and every small and great thing is inscribed.
The righteous will be among gardens and rivers, in a seat of honor near a Sovereign, Perfect in Ability.
The Most Merciful taught the Quran, created man and taught him eloquence.
The sun and moon move by precise calculation, and the stars and trees prostrate.
Allah raised the heaven and set the balance, so do not transgress in it; establish weight in justice and do not make the balance deficient.
Allah laid out the earth for the creatures, with fruit, palm trees, grain and scented plants, then asks which of your Lord's favors you would deny.
Allah created man from clay like pottery and the jinn from a smokeless flame of fire.
He is Lord of the two sunrises and two sunsets, released the two seas with a barrier between them yielding pearl and coral, and owns ships like mountains.
Everyone on earth will perish, and the Face of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor, will remain.
All in the heavens and earth ask of Him, and every day He is bringing about a matter.
Jinn and mankind will be attended to and cannot pass beyond heaven and earth without authority; flame and smoke will come, the heaven will split, and none asked about sin.
The criminals are known by their marks and seized by forelocks and feet; this is the Hell they denied, where they go between it and scalding water.
Whoever feared his Lord's position will have two gardens with flowing springs, two kinds of every fruit, silk-lined beds and women of restrained glance; the reward for good is good.
Below these two are two other dark green gardens with two spouting springs, fruit, palm trees and pomegranates, good and beautiful women reserved in pavilions, and green cushions and carpets.
Blessed is the name of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.
When the Occurrence comes it lowers some and raises others; the earth shakes, mountains crumble to dust, and people become three groups: right, left and forerunners.
The forerunners, brought near, many from the former peoples and few from the later, recline on thrones in the Gardens of Pleasure with drink, fruit, fowl and fair women.
The companions of the right, from the former and the later peoples, enjoy thornless lote trees, extended shade, flowing water, abundant fruit, raised beds and the women of Paradise.
The companions of the left, who lived in luxury, persisted in the great violation and doubted being raised, will have scorching fire, scalding water, black smoke and the zaqqum tree.
Allah, who created people from the fluid they emit and decreed death among them, can recreate them in a form they do not know, as the first creation shows.
Allah asks who grows the sown seed, sends down drinking water and produced the tree for fire; He could ruin crops and water, so exalt the name of your Lord.
